summary: Sigma Lithium filed a Form 6-K disclosing that all mining and industrial production was temporarily suspended on September 30, 2026, due to an atypical 15-day delay by the Federal Court of Appeals in reviewing its Emergency Motion for Suspensive Relief. The underlying suit, brought by NGO Ngolo, seeks suspension of the company's Minas Gerais environmental licenses; Sigma asserts its distance to Quilombola settlements exceeds legal limits. Management maintains FY27 guidance of 330,000t but postpones 12-month 240,000t guidance by three months, continuing fines sales and self-funding. Watch licensing/appeal rulings and restart timing.
